Forest Service trail pages for Tomyhoi Lake #686 and Yellow Aster Butte #686.1 list only a recreation pass and say wilderness regulations apply; the MBS permit/regulation pages describe mandatory self-issue permits only for the Alpine Lakes Wilderness. WTA says only that other national-forest wilderness trailheads 'may' have a self-registration kiosk. No two sources settle whether a self-issue wilderness permit is required here, and the conflicting text is in bivy[0].permit, which this pass may not patch.
